status: Exploratory protocol frozen after an initial run-pattern listing; not preregistered or held-out
hypothesis: Every maximal contiguous run of the specified tally candidates is a single numerical field, and its graphic classes follow one fixed global monotone order in source file order. Repeated members of the same class are allowed.
scope: Tests this universal grammar extension, not every additive or positional numeral theory; adjacency is an explicit field-boundary assumption.
membership_provenance: Same candidate families as screen_numeral_pairs.py. This is an inherited operational classification, not a new visual authentication. W900 is excluded because it is not one of these stroke classes. W020 and W025-W029, modifier signs and all other signs remain unassigned.
conservative_provenance: Restricts long to catalogue features P144/P145/P147/P150/P151 and stacked to explicit stacked descriptions P139/P140; short P121-P127. These secondary descriptions are not independent photographs.
models: stacked shares long rank: both orders
stacked shares short rank: both orders
selection: Existing parse_lipi strict complete single-line R/L selection. Separate L/R sensitivity removes only the direction failure. Retain all other failures. Do not reverse or repair text.
segmentation_alternative: For a selected order, every class-rank descent requires a boundary if each resulting field must be monotone. This is a mathematical minimum under that order, not evidence that any boundary existed.
exclusions: Preserve every source row with a literal candidate code and its parse failures. Unknown signs break runs and are never skipped.
identification: No numeric value, base, unit, sound, language or word is identified by passing or failing this grammar test. Order-free addition permits all permutations and is a surviving structural countermodel.
